subject: Renewal kickoff: capacity migration, term amendment, and QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Malik <sana@NimbusPay.com>, Roberto Diaz <rdiaz@NimbusPay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Mar 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff: capacity migration, term amendment, and QBR scheduling

Hi Sana / Roberto —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Per our discussion, this thread will kick off the renewal + expansion coordination so we have a single source of truth for timelines, owners, and the QBR booking. High level items we discussed:

- Term amendment to add a 12-month committed capacity uplift (see attached capacity_recommendation_2029Q2.xlsx).
- Option to move a subset of workloads to Dedicated for predictable throughput during payroll peaks (proposal in attached SOW).
- QBR to review performance SLAs, rollout plan, and billing impact (looking for a 60–90 minute slot with execs + infra).

As next steps from our side:
1) I attached a draft SOW and the capacity recommendation table for your review.
2) Ben will surface pricing/crediting options for the uplift.
3) Karthik will owner the Dedicated migration runbook and timing.

Can you share preferred windows for a QBR between Mar 25–Apr 4? I’ll send a calendar poll once I get a sense of what works for your execs. Also flag any legal or procurement constraints we should be aware of early (term language, liability, data residency).

Attachments: NimbusPay_draft_SOW_v1.pdf (draft amendment), capacity_recommendation_2029Q2.xlsx

Thanks — look forward to getting this scheduled.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart

Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: capacity migration, term amendment, and QBR scheduling

Thanks Evelyn — this is helpful. Roberto and I reviewed the attachments; a couple quick items from our side:

- We like the Dedicated pilot for peak payroll windows but need clarification on the failover policy (what happens if Dedicated capacity is saturated and jobs spill back to hosted). Can Karthik outline fallback SLAs?
- Legal flagged a short list of term edits (limits on liability and data retention language). I’ll loop Legal Ops if that’s OK.
- QBR windows: Mar 27 (afternoon PT) or Apr 2 (morning PT) work best for our execs.

Would it be possible to get a version of the SOW with the proposed SLA/fallback language called out as tracked changes? That will speed review on our side.

Appreciate the quick review, Sana. Two quick notes from finance/pricing:

- We can propose a stepped commit: 60% reserved for Q2, ramp to 100% by Nov 2029. I’ll put numbers in a short table and share by EOD.
- On credits: we can offer a one-time onboarding credit for the Dedicated pilot if the pilot triggers by May 31.

I started a calendar poll here: https://calendly.com/redwood-qbr/nimbuspay-qbr — I put tentative slots on Mar 27 2:00pm PT and Apr 2 10:00am PT per Sana’s note. Evelyn / Karthik — can you confirm which slot you want me to lock?

Thanks everyone — consolidating next steps and owners so we have clear runway: 

1) QBR booked: Mar 27, 2029, 2:00–3:30 PM PT (confirmed on calendly & invite sent). Attendees: NimbusPay execs (Sana, Roberto), Redwood exec (Evelyn), Infra lead (Karthik), Finance (Ben), Legal Ops (NimbusPay).
2) SOW updates: I’ll add the fallback SLA text for Dedicated -> hosted spillover and call out autoscale thresholds. Expect tracked-change SOW back by Mon Mar 25 EOD.
3) Pricing table: Ben will share stepped commit numbers and onboarding credit line item (target: Fri Mar 15 — completed).
4) Legal/procurement: Legal Ops (cc’d) — please review the tracked changes and flag any non-starter clauses.
5) DocuSign: once SOW + amendment language approved, we’ll route an amendment via DocuSign (link will be posted in-thread).

Quick notes on fallback SLA (preview): automatic reroute within 30s to hosted pool with priority queuing for mission-critical requests; dedicated pool alerts + 2-hour remediation SLO for degraded throughput. We’ll surface the exact throttling thresholds in the tracked document.

Attachments: none in this message.

Cheers —
